title: Cinema with a quiz
content: I think this was my first mallword dream (woo I joined the club, yay) and just wondering whether anyone had a dream like this. I was in a cinema (movie theatre for you folks across the pond) it didn't look like my local cinema. It had purple seats. I went and sat down to watch the movie, but there was no movie. It was just a quiz, with questions I had to answer. There was a popcorn emoji at one point. I don't remember the questions I was being asked, I woke up after the last question had been asked.
